description: Labeled turns for the recipe prediction behind speculative dispatch: which installed recipe the main agent's first dispatch will name. Every turn warrants workers. Labels say which recipe should run, not what a past session did. Turns marked verbatim are operator turns from session ledgers, where every dispatching turn launched scout unless the operator named another agent; the rest are synthetic controls, one or more per recipe family, so a predictor that always answers scout scores 9 of 24.
